title: Alex Farms Hairy Vetch Cover Crop
reason: Provides information on farming practices for growing sweet corn and using hairy vetch as a cover crop.

tasks.task: Discuss farming practices for growing sweet corn sustainably.

subtasks.text: Explain the importance of adequate soil fertility in growing marketable sweet corn.
Mention the use of ecological production practices to grow corn without excessive use of chemicals.
Describe the role of healthy cover crops in protecting natural resources.

tasks.task: Explain the farmer's experience with hairy vetch as a cover crop.

subtasks.text: Highlight the farmer's motivation for finding cover crops that fit well with intensive vegetable production.
Describe the preferred rate of seeding vetch and the reasons for choosing it.
Explain the process of turning the vetch under in preparation for planting.
Note the benefits of using vetch as a cover crop, including additional biomass and nitrogen.
Mention the main drawback to using vetch and the farmer's intention to continue using it.
